name: A Plan Generations in the Making
summary: At the end of your Command phase, an objective marker this unit controls within range stays under your control with no models near it, until the opponent controls it at a turn's start or end.

name: Aerial Seeding
summary: This model starts in Reserves (not counted against reserve limits) and can arrive in your first, second, or third Movement phase; embarked units must disembark more than 8" from enemies immediately, and no unit can embark afterward.

name: Alchemicus Familiar
summary: Once per battle when this unit fights, add 1 to the Wound roll for its attacks against Infantry units until end of phase.

name: Alpha Invader
summary: Weapons equipped by models in this unit have the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Alpha Warrior
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Battlefield Analysis
summary: Once per battle round, when this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's Command Point cost by 1.

name: Bio-horror Disruption (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Biological Warfare
summary: Once per battle when this model's unit fights, improve the Attacks and Damage characteristics of its injector goad by 3 until end of phase.

name: BODYGUARD
summary: While this model leads a unit, other CHARACTER models attached to that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Brood Surge
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: Claimed for the Cult
summary: At the start of your Command phase, roll a D6 for each controlled objective marker with a model bearing this ability nearby; a 4+ on any die gains 1 Command Point.

name: Cloaked Assassin
summary: Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap-shooting attacks.

name: Cosmic Horror (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Creeping Shadow
summary: While equipped with a cult sniper rifle, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Crossfire
summary: After this unit shoots, pick one enemy unit it hit; until end of turn, the first attack a friendly Genestealer Cults unit makes against it gains +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Cult Demagogue
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in that unit can add 1 to the Hit roll.

name: Cult Icon
summary: In your Command phase, return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer's unit (up to 3, or more if within range of a controlled objective), excluding attached Characters.

name: Cult Infiltration
summary: At the start of each player's Command phase, move one of your Cult Ambush markers that hasn't moved this turn up to 6".

name: Death Blow
summary: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase, roll a D6: on a 4+ it fights after the attacker's unit finishes, then is removed.

name: Death From Below
summary: At the end of the opponent's turn, if this unit is not in Engagement Range of any enemy unit, remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.

name: Decoys and Misdirection
summary: After deployment, redeploy up to three Genestealer Cults units, optionally placing them in Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal Strategic Reserves limit.

name: Demolition Run
summary: Once per turn, after this unit moves, roll a D6 per model in it against an enemy unit within 6" and visible; each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound, up to 6.

name: Fear of the Unseen (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6", worsen its Leadership by 1; if that unit is below Starting Strength, it must take a Battle-shock test in the opponent's Command phase.

name: Feeder Tendrils
summary: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character model, gain 1 Command Point.

name: Flare Launcher
summary: The bearer's unit gains the Smoke keyword and can be targeted by the Smokescreen Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Grinding Clearance
summary: When a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit within this model's Engagement Range Falls Back, its models take a Desperate Escape test, with a -1 penalty if that unit is Battle-shocked.

name: Heroic Fusillade
summary: Once per turn, after this model shoots, pick an Infantry unit it hit; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Hulking Bodyguards
summary: While a Character leads this unit, attacks against it with a Strength greater than this unit's Toughness suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: HUNTER ORGANISM
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Hypersensory Abilities
summary: Once per turn in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this model, if outside Engagement Range it can shoot that unit as if in your Shooting phase, then make a Normal move of up to D6" (no embarking).

name: Hypersensory Array
summary: Once per battle round you can target this unit with Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention at -1 CP; that use neither blocks nor is blocked by other uses of that Stratagem this phase.

name: Industrialised Destruction
summary: Attacks by models in this unit re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll entirely against an enemy unit within range of an objective marker.

name: It Itches!
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, pick an enemy unit within this model's Engagement Range; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Manufactorum Cover
summary: If this Fortification blocks visibility to a model targeted by a ranged attack, that model gains Benefit of Cover against the attack.

name: Master Outrider
summary: After this model's unit shoots, if not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" as in the Movement phase, but cannot then charge that turn.

name: Might From Beyond
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Mind Control (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, target an enemy unit within 18" and roll a D6: on a 1 this model takes D3 mortal wounds; on 2-5 that unit suffers -1 to Hit rolls until end of phase; on a 6 it also suffers -1 to Wound rolls.

name: Neural Disruption
summary: In your Command phase, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this model; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Nexus of Devotion
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability, or 4+ if the unit is Hybrid Metamorphs.

name: Outrider Gangs
summary: When this unit arrives via Cult Ambush, its models must set up within 9" of a battlefield edge with at least one touching a Cult Ambush marker, which is then removed; otherwise it cannot be set up.

name: Parasitic Infection
summary: Each time this model's barbed ovipositor destroys an Infantry model, you may add a new D3-model Ripper Swarms unit within 3" of this model, possibly within Engagement Range of the destroyed model's unit.

name: Paroxysm (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, target a visible enemy unit within 12" and roll a D6: on a 1 this model takes D3 mortal wounds; on 2+ that unit's weapons lose 1 Attack until end of phase.

name: Pheromone Trail
summary: Once per battle round, target a model with this ability with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Planted Explosives
summary: Once per battle, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this model, it can use its Reductus mine: roll one D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. One model in your army per battle round.

name: Priority Target
summary: After this model's unit shoots, pick an enemy unit hit by its cult sniper rifle attacks; until end of phase, friendly Genestealer Cults attacks against it re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Psionic Shield (Psychic)
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model gains a 4+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

name: Psychic Familiar
summary: Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, this model can add 6" to the range of its Mind Control ability until the end of the phase.

name: Psychic Spoor
summary: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit as this model's prey; attacks this model makes against it can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

name: Psychological Saboteur (Aura)
summary: While a Battle-shocked enemy unit is within 12", its attacks suffer -1 to the Hit roll, and friendly Tyranids attacks against it get +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Regenerating Gene-mass
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on a 2+, set it back up at full wounds near where it died, not within Engagement Range of any enemy.

name: Scrambler Array
summary: Enemy Reinforcement units cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

name: Spotter
summary: The bearer's ranged weapons have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+.

name: Subterranean Tunnels
summary: When this model Deep Strikes, it may arrive anywhere more than 6" from all enemy units, but cannot charge until the following turn.

name: Sudden Assault
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have the Fights First ability.

name: Summon the Cult
summary: Once per battle, when a Cult Ambush marker would be removed for enemy proximity, you can instead place it within 12" of a model with this ability and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units; if impossible, it is removed.

name: Survey Augur
summary: After the bearer's unit shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; until end of phase, friendly Genestealer Cults attacks against that unit gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Swift and Deadly
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Tectonic Fragdrill
summary: Friendly Genestealer Cults Infantry models can be set up or end moves on top of this Fortification's floor sections.

name: Terror From The Deep
summary: When this model Deep Strikes, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 12": on 2-4 it suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 5+ it suffers 3 mortal wounds and must take a Battle-shock test.

name: The Chosen One
summary: While this model leads a unit, a model in that unit destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase can, on a D6 roll of 4+, fight after the attacker's unit finishes, then is removed.

name: Twisted Science
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Underground Egress
summary: Each time one of your Cult Ambush markers would be removed for an enemy ending a move within 8" of it, you can instead move it wholly within 8" of this Fortification and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, if possible.

name: Voice of New Truths
summary: In your Command phase, pick an enemy unit within 18"; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Will of the Hive Mind
summary: Once per battle round, when a friendly Tyranids unit within 12" is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's Command Point cost by 1.

name: Winged Swarm
summary: After this unit shoots, if not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6"; if it does, it cannot charge this turn.

name: Cult Ambush
summary: Destroyed units made entirely of models with this ability can return via Cult Ambush by spending Resurgence points (by battle size, cost by unit size); a marker is placed, letting units ingress near it, removed if an enemy nears within 8".

name: Shadow in the Warp
summary: Once per battle, in either player's Command phase, if your Army Faction is Tyranids and a unit with this ability is on the battlefield, force every enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test, at -1 within 6" of a friendly SYNAPSE unit.

name: Shadow In The Warp (Ravener Prime only)
summary: Once per battle, in either player's Command phase, if your Army Faction is Tyranids and a unit with this ability is on the battlefield, force every enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test, at -1 within 6" of a friendly SYNAPSE unit.

name: Synapse
summary: If your Army Faction is Tyranids, a Tyranids unit within 6" of a friendly SYNAPSE model is in Synapse Range: it takes Battle-shock tests on 3D6 instead of 2D6, and its melee attacks get +1 Strength.
